subject: move the two SKILL.md files to .pi/skills/ with relative symlinks from .claude/skills/ (placement ruled)
activeForm: Relocating the repo's skills to the ruled dual-harness layout

work_items: git mv .claude/skills/<name> to .pi/skills/<name> for canon-audit and adversarial-repo-mapping
Create .claude/skills/<name> as a RELATIVE symlink to ../../.pi/skills/<name> for each
Verify both harnesses list both skills; a plausible directory shape is not evidence

description:
DECIDED 2026-09-22 by operator ruling, recorded on the dotfiles board at f55bae6 (cards/goal.json, ruling (4), 'skill placement on a dual-harness host ruled for ~/projects/sentiment-analyzer-gsk card 13'): the real directory is .pi/skills/<name>/SKILL.md, .claude/skills/<name> is a RELATIVE symlink to it, and both traversals were measured there. .agents/skills is pi-only and is not the answer for a repo that runs both harnesses. No design question remains; this card is now mechanical.

WHY. This repo carries .claude/skills/canon-audit/SKILL.md and .claude/skills/adversarial-repo-mapping/SKILL.md. pi never reads .claude/skills/ (zero hits for that path across its dist); its project roots are <cwd>/.pi/{extensions,skills,prompts,themes} (package-manager.js:1962-1967) and it loads SKILL.md natively (skills.js:117-137). Every Dynamo runs pi, so today no Dynamo can reach either skill.

DO NOT move them to .pi/prompts/. That was the original report's suggestion and it is wrong for skills: prompts become slash commands, which strips model invocation.

RELATIVE, NOT ABSOLUTE. An absolute symlink resolves to the root checkout from inside a card worktree, so a Dynamo would read main's copy instead of its own branch's. The relative target from .claude/skills/<name> is ../../.pi/skills/<name>.

DONE WHEN each skill is listed by pi and by Claude Code from the root checkout AND from a card worktree, and `git ls-files -s .claude/skills` shows mode 120000 for both entries.
